ev: The Rockbridge County 911 Call Center reported that Sycamore Valley Drive is flooded near the creek. No damage was reported to the road, which was open to traffic after the flooding receded.

The 911 Call Center in Rockbridge County reported that near the intersection of Chestnut Grove Trail and Hackens Road near the adjacent creek is flooded, with debris in the roadway. The damage estimate is the cost of removing debris from the road.

Runoff from intense rainfall caused Kerrs Creek near Lexington, VA (KCKV2) to rise 6.75 feet in 45 minutes to a crest at 9.56 feet at 9:00 pm EST above the minor flood stage of 8 feet. The 911 Call Center in Rockbridge County, VA reported three water rescues along Kerrs Creek between 7:20 pm EST and 9:20 pm EST. Property damage is the estimated damage to the automobiles.
